title: Company. Etsy: Building an Internet Marketplace in the Shadows of eBay and Amazon

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this episode of The Synopsis.
reader_summary.overview: In this episode of The Synopsis. We dovetail into what makes the platform unique and how Etsy has been able to succeed where both eBay and Amazon failed. We draw on Speedwell's 79 page report to teach not just about Etsy, but also help investors learn about how great CEOs run a business.
